title: alnus cordifolia var. subcordata
intro: Alnus cordifolia var. subcordata, commonly known as Mountain Alder, is a variety of the Mountain Alder tree, native to North America. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree with numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Alder include pain relief, wound healing, and anti-diarrheal effects, primarily due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
